reading_rule: Complete selected scientific source values, with custody-only fields removed as documented. Author-state tokens remain dated source history; original later qualification governs scientific acceptance.

common_contract.domain: The named current engineering work, configuration, response horizon and actual receiving use in each record. A nominally related tool or an arbitrary possible application is insufficient.
common_contract.reserve_guard: For an EL-008 relation, consequential residual variability or disruption affects the named evidence, repair or commitment path, and a particular physical/time/capacity reserve or feasible recovery option is actually proposed or used on that path. The member identifies what the reserve protects and which receiver premise consumes that fact. Mere assertion that every activity uses resources is excluded.
common_contract.signal_guard: For an admitted EL-010 relation, the named event or demand record is actually consumed to release/replenish the named work or consequential order. Origin, item/unit, configuration where relevant, freshness, authority, forecast complement and exception treatment have their native roles. Truthful information in general is not a demand signal.
common_contract.materiality: A warranted change to an actual input, scope, feasible response, evidential interpretation or decision premise can be material even when the final action is unchanged and other receiver premises remain open. No whole-receiver proof or action-flip requirement is imposed.
common_contract.unknown_rule: Examined unknown means the specific native interface needed for this candidate has not been established by the completed inquiry. It is neither an unexamined row nor a demonstrated absence in every context. A useful partial interface could resolve it without proving the whole receiver.
common_contract.evidence_kinds: Exact selected native propositions and criticism; author conditional mechanism reasoning; selected source-register metadata at its recorded historical, analytical, observational or guidance ceiling; and the separately executed exposed finite C21 construction. No new primary-source body access, independent replication, measured software effect, historical genealogy or universal reserve optimum is claimed.
common_contract.authority: Reserve availability, a genuine request, useful negative evidence and a passing evaluation do not create permission to commit resources, waive a binding condition or expand release authority. Actual authorized holds and cheap permitted response paths remain available.
common_contract.cost_and_dependence: Count standby, carrying/obsolescence, activation, maintenance, signal reconciliation, waiting, expediting and displaced work across the actual boundary. Count a shared resource, source work or event once. Correlated failures and one common oracle/pipeline are not independent protection. Rights and binding constraints remain separate from economic weights.
common_contract.removal: Removing a named implementation is acceptable when the remaining or cheaper mechanism still supplies the actual needed function. It is not acceptable to relabel an absent reserve, invalid evidence or an unserved real request as successful removal. Reconsider all causally affected consumers on changed identity, scope, timing, failure correlation, authority or obligations.
common_contract.LA001_scope: EL-010 remains demand/replenishment information integrity. LA-001 qualifies only its flow-profile BUFFER_ASSUMPTIONS sentence using EL-008's residual-variability/no-universal-buffer boundary. The new prospective-frontier correction preserves I001 unchanged.

native_factor_interpretations.EL-008: A usable reserve portfolio must state the residual variability, protected consequence, available material/capacity/time and feasible activation path. Information and a dormant alternative are not interchangeable with available resources. No universal positive buffer is required.
native_factor_interpretations.EL-010: A governed demand/replenishment signal has a defined source, event and unit, freshness, authority and consumption by a release decision. Short-term withdrawal must be complemented by forecasts/capacity where lead times require them. It does not govern every true fact or every test result.
native_factor_interpretations.EA-02: Integrated behavior is exercised against the current claim with configuration identity, representative environment, an oracle and known scope. A model/proof/prototype can be the cheaper sufficient evidence. Availability of evaluation capacity and validity of the resulting evidence are different premises.
native_factor_interpretations.EA-07: Interacting changes are actually merged into an authoritative mainline, credibly verified, and failures repaired promptly. A failure that triggers repair supplies a real work-demand interface; a green badge without integration does not. Low-change coherent integration remains adequate.
native_factor_interpretations.EW-P021: An empowered actor uses discriminating current evidence and residual risk to decide an actual consequential commitment, with a real hold/redirect/stop option. Long-lead procurement provides an explicit demand/commitment interface. A review calendar does not create readiness or reserve authority.
native_factor_interpretations.EW-P031: Recurring configuration-linked evidence, operational monitoring and actual promotion/authority consumption are distinct roles. Rapid-remediation demand can be generated by monitored failures. Provenance/coverage and required human or independent judgment constrain which standby capability is usable; pipeline throughput alone is insufficient.

literal_argument.shared_object: The actual representative integrated-evaluation activity whose response is needed for the stated behavioral claim before a consequential decision.
guard: The same evaluation has material residual duration/disruption variability.
A specifically available time margin or compatible evaluation-capacity reserve is proposed for that activity and is used in judging when and how appropriate evidence can be obtained.
Representative environment, claim and configuration are identified; a generic team staffing claim is insufficient.
literal_argument.source_contribution: EL-008 separates usable capacity or an allowed response margin from a reserve name, information about capacity and an accidental queue; it identifies which disruption the actual reserve can absorb.
literal_argument.receiving_consequence: EA-02's evidence-plan feasibility and response premise changes: the specified representative evaluation may remain available before its needed decision, or a claimed substitution may be rejected as incapable/late. This does not turn a timely result into a valid result.
remaining_premises: Oracle credibility, representative environment, configuration correspondence and evidence scope.
Actual reserve availability/activation rights, relevant disruption data and the legitimate decision horizon.
literal_argument.positive_witness: A compatible available evaluation reserve preserves the same integrated exercise during the named primary-resource outage; only the response premise improves.
literal_argument.stronger_claim_counterexample: A fast standby environment uses mocked dependencies. It meets a date but cannot support the real integration claim; calling it reserve does not cure demo theatre.
literal_argument.nontrigger: No material residual variability affects this evaluation, or the proposed reserve is unrelated to the actual evidence activity.
literal_argument.cheap_alternative_and_cost: Use the smallest appropriate model/proof/test and an allowed time margin when sufficient. Compare reserve upkeep and activation with waiting and delayed decision consequences; a stable low-load baseline can need no added spare.
literal_argument.removal_test: Remove the spare if the actual adequate evidence path still meets the legitimate response need; retain its protected function if removal would substitute an unrepresentative demonstration or silently move delay elsewhere.
literal_argument.evidence_anchor: Native EA-02 already requires representative integrated exercise. This member concerns capacity/time for that exact activity; it does not invent a supplier tool or claim that arbitrary reserve software is under test.
